headline: Portage Park anchors a ward with the lowest landlord profit margins in Chicago.
summary:
Portage Park, Belmont Cragin, Irving Park, and Avondale fall inside Ward 30, on Chicago's Northwest Side. A composite score of 45.96 lands it 24th out of 50, close to the middle of the city. Two different things carry the ward's best numbers, landlord finances and city upkeep. On two separate measures of how much of a tenant's rent ends up as landlord profit, this ward posts the lowest share of the fifty. Chicago 311 also closes garbage cart repair requests faster here than in most of the city, and no park drinking fountain here has ever tested positive for elevated lead.

Public amenities are where this ward comes up short. There is no mapped library in the ward, parks and civic gathering spots are scarcer than in almost any other ward, and parking complaints run higher here than in most other wards.
reading_the_rankings: Two of these numbers ride on the city's aldermanic menu-money records, and those got redrawn right along with the ward lines in 2023. The ward's menu spending is unusually spread out across the area, a measure that ranks second of 50, but that same source also puts the ward 47th of 50 on how much of its yearly menu allotment, close to $1.5 million, actually got committed to projects in the latest full year, at 79.2 percent. Measuring this ward's spending pattern against its own history means measuring it against boundaries that in some cases did not exist in this shape before that year, so there is not much of a track record yet to compare either ranking to. The garbage cart repair time, ranked 4th at under 20 days, carries a smaller catch. The underlying 311 field here is thinner than the full fifty, so the comparison holds for the wards it covers but is not complete citywide.

news.headline: Homeless Shelter Coming To Far Northwest Side: 'This Is Overdue'
news.note: State and city officials, including Ald. Ruth Cruz, secured $13 million in state funds to build a shelter for older adults in the 30th Ward.
